bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
root=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core
p="$root/.worktrees/qwen35-gate-candidate-20261128"
target=a47c4b7fe5289b8d1e7a2c104a00fb0dd27bfac5
test -z "$(git -C "$p" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
git -C "$p" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/feat/qwen35-gate-candidate-20261128
test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$target"
git -C "$p" merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD "$target"
git -C "$p" checkout --detach "$target"
cd "$p"
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_qwen_distillation.py' -v
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_remote_model_gate.py' -v
echo DISTILLATION_CONTRACT_AND_GATE_TESTS=PASS
python3 -B - "$root" "$target" <<'PY'
import json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
state=root/'.ai-core'
assert not state.is_symlink()
state.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
venv=state/'distillation-venv'
assert not venv.is_symlink()
result={'head':sys.argv[2],'contract_tests':9,'remote_gate_tests':6,'training_updates':0,'package_state':'NOT_READY'}
started=time.monotonic()
deadline=started+100
def run(cmd):
    remain=deadline-time.monotonic()
    if remain<=1: return 124
    try:
        with (state/'distillation-setup.log').open('ab') as log:
            return subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=remain).returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return 124
try:
    if not (venv/'bin/python').is_file():
        rc=run([sys.executable,'-m','venv',str(venv)])
    else: rc=0
    result['venv_exit']=rc
    if rc==0:
        py=str(venv/'bin/python')
        common=[py,'-m','pip','--isolated','--disable-pip-version-check','install','--no-input','--only-binary=:all:']
        rc=run(common+['--index-url','https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu','torch==2.10.0'])
        result['torch_install_exit']=rc
        if rc==0:
            rc=run(common+['--index-url','https://pypi.org/simple','torch==2.10.0','transformers==5.24.1','peft==0.22.0'])
            result['libraries_install_exit']=rc
            if rc==0:
                rc=run([py,'-m','pip','--isolated','check'])
                result['pip_check_exit']=rc
                if rc==0:
                    probe=subprocess.run([py,'-c','import torch,transformers,peft,json;from transformers import Qwen3_5ForCausalLM;print(json.dumps({"torch":torch.__version__,"transformers":transformers.__version__,"peft":peft.__version__,"cuda":torch.cuda.is_available(),"qwen_class":Qwen3_5ForCausalLM.__name__}))'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
                    result['import_exit']=probe.returncode
                    if probe.returncode==0:
                        result['versions']=json.loads(probe.stdout.splitlines()[-1])
                        assert result['versions']['cuda'] is False
                        result['package_state']='CPU_ENV_IMPORT_READY'
except Exception as ex:
    result['error']=type(ex).__name__
result['elapsed_seconds']=round(time.monotonic()-started,2)
body='## Qwen LoRA backend exact-source tests and isolated CPU dependency setup\n\n```json\n'+json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n```\n\nNo base model replacement, global package installation, provider call, or KB training. CPU speed/weight loading not qualified.'
subprocess.run(['gh','issue','comment','1','--repo','seigo-gace/ai-core','--body-file','-'],input=body,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=20)
print(json.dumps(result))
if result['package_state']!='CPU_ENV_IMPORT_READY': sys.exit(2)
PY
